document_overview.name: Industrial-Grade Closed-Loop Hybrid WAF (v2 Elite)
document_overview.purpose: Provide a high-performance web application firewall that combines signature-based security with AI, offering rapid attack classification, adversarial resilience, and self-healing capabilities.
document_overview.description: The document describes a hybrid WAF system that achieves 97.9% detection accuracy, sub‑2ms inference latency, and an automated feedback loop for continuous learning. It outlines the system’s architecture, training data sources, key features, and project directory layout.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.description: Introduces the project as a high‑performance Hybrid WAF that bridges traditional signature‑based security and modern AI, highlighting its inference speed and recursive normalization layer.

sections.heading: The "v2 Elite" Brain
sections.description: Describes the training data composition for the AI model, specifying three datasets and their contribution percentages.

sections.heading: Key Features
sections.description: Lists the primary capabilities of the system, including detection accuracy, adversarial resilience, hybrid risk engine, low latency, and self‑healing loop.

sections.heading: Project Structure
sections.description: Outlines the modular directory layout and key scripts/modules that implement the WAF’s functionality.

entities.name: Hybrid WAF
entities.description: An industrial‑grade, closed‑loop security system that detects web attacks using both AI and deterministic signatures.

entities.name: Inference Engine
entities.description: Classifies HTTP traffic in less than 1.6 ms using an ONNX Runtime model.

entities.name: Recursive Normalization Layer
entities.description: Normalizes incoming requests through recursive unquoting to defeat evasion techniques.

entities.name: "v2 Elite" Brain
entities.description: The AI model trained on a tri‑source dataset to recognize modern web attacks.

entities.name: CSE-CIC-IDS2018 Dataset
entities.description: Provides 65 % of the training data, teaching behavioral network flow patterns.

entities.name: OWASP Juice Shop Dataset
entities.description: Provides 35 % of the training data, teaching modern REST API and NoSQL attacks.

entities.name: CSIC Augmented Dataset
entities.description: Baseline dataset that supplies a foundational HTTP attack vocabulary.

entities.name: 97.9% Accuracy
entities.description: Overall detection accuracy across supported attack categories (SQLi, XSS, Path Traversal, Log4j, SSRF).

entities.name: Adversarial Resilience
entities.description: Built‑in mutation engine that generates over 40,000 attack variants to prevent bypasses.

entities.name: Hybrid Risk Engine
entities.description: Combines ML confidence scores with deterministic signature matching and recursive normalization to compute risk.

entities.name: Sub‑2ms Latency
entities.description: Inference latency optimized to less than 2 ms per request in production.

entities.name: Self‑Healing Loop
entities.description: Automated pipeline that bridges quarantined logs, allows human verification, and triggers a protected retraining step (Promotion Gate).

entities.name: core/
entities.description: Contains the core WAF logic.

entities.name: waf_api.py
entities.description: FastAPI inference server with hot‑reloading capability.

entities.name: risk_engine.py
entities.description: Implements hybrid logic with recursive unquoting and signature matching.

entities.name: models/
entities.description: Stores ML artifacts such as ONNX models, scalers, and vectorizers.

entities.name: scripts/
entities.description: Contains automation and intelligence utilities.

entities.name: retrain_brain.py
entities.description: Self‑healing training pipeline that retrains the model after verification.

entities.name: augment_data.py
entities.description: Adversarial data mutation engine that creates 40,000+ attack variants (double encoding, comment injection).

entities.name: generate_juice_payloads.py
entities.description: Generates modern API attack payloads based on the OWASP Juice Shop dataset.

entities.name: evaluate_model.py
entities.description: Comprehensive benchmark suite for measuring accuracy, latency, and robustness.

entities.name: data/
entities.description: Holds training sets and behavioral logs used by the system.
